        for r in range(h)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the solid divider, ignoring uniform lines on the outer border.
    divider = None
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            divider = ("row", r)
            break
    if divider is None:
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
                if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
                    divider = ("col", c)
                    break

    if divider[0] == "row":
        k = divider[1]
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
        height, width = min(len(a), len(b)), w
        def bg(panel):
            from collections import Counter
            return Counter(x for row in panel for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        ba, bb = bg(a), bg(b)
        fill = ba if ba == bb else 0
        return [[3 if a[r][c] != ba and b[r][c] != bb else fill
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
    else:
        k = divider[1]
        left = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        right = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(k, w - k - 1)
        from collections import Counter
        ba = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        bb = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        fill = ba if ba == bb else 0
        return [[3 if left[r][c] != ba and right[r][c] != bb else fill
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_div = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if row_div is not None:
        first = grid[:row_div]
        second = grid[row_div + 1:]
        shared = set(x for row in first for x in row) & set(x for row in second for x in row)
        fill = min(shared)
        return [
            [3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else fill for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(min(len(first), len(second)))
        ]

    col_div = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    first = [row[:col_div] for row in grid]
    second = [row[col_div + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in first for x in row) & set(x for row in second for x in row)
    fill = min(shared)
    width = min(len(first[0]), len(second[0]))
    return [
        [3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else fill for c in range(width)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
